home.outcomesTitle: What you will be able to do
home.outcomesSubtitle: By the end you can deliver an end-to-end CRM Analytics solution — and prove it.

outcomes.d: Connect Salesforce and external sources, schedule reliable syncs, and keep datasets fresh.
Join, aggregate, and clean raw data into trustworthy, well-modeled datasets.
Author queries by hand for advanced metrics, windowing, and dashboard interactivity.
Design responsive, faceted dashboards with drill-downs and embedded Salesforce actions.
Train explainable Einstein Discovery models and surface predictions on records and in flows.
Cover the skills measured by the CRM Analytics & Einstein Discovery Consultant exam.

home.whoTitle: Built for every role on the team

personas.d: Go from drag-and-drop reports to building datasets, SAQL, and dashboards that scale.
Set up the platform, manage security predicates, and roll analytics out safely.
Design end-to-end solutions and prep for the certification with confidence.
Start from CRM basics — no prior analytics experience required.

faqs.a: Yes — every lesson is free and open source, with no sign-up required.

faqs.q: Do I need a Salesforce org?
faqs.a: A free Developer Edition org is enough to follow along with every lesson.
No. We start from CRM basics and introduce SAQL gradually, step by step.

faqs.q: Will this help me get certified?
faqs.a: The curriculum maps to the CRM Analytics & Einstein Discovery Consultant exam topics.

features.d: Lessons walk you through connecting Salesforce, Snowflake, and files; scheduling syncs; and shaping everything into clean datasets with visual recipes.
Practice writing SAQL and building lenses, then assemble fast, interactive dashboards with bindings, faceting, and drill-downs — all in your own free org.

features.t: Learn to predict what happens next
features.d: Follow guided exercises to train explainable Einstein Discovery models and surface predictions and recommendations right where your team works.

home.projectsSubtitle: Real dashboards you can recreate as you learn — then share your own with the community.

projects.d: Track stages, win rate, and forecast in one interactive view.
Score accounts with Einstein Discovery and act before they leave.
Case volume, CSAT, and resolution time for support teams.
Break revenue down geographically with drill-downs.
Rank performance with windowed SAQL and faceting.
Attribute pipeline to campaigns and measure return.

points: One technology, deeply: only CRM Analytics

deliver.title: From a single dashboard to a full rollout
deliver.lead: The same skills the course teaches, applied to your org and your data by people who do it every week.

servicesDesc.dashboards: Executive, pipeline and service dashboards designed around a decision — fast, faceted and readable.
servicesDesc.pipelines: Connections, sync and recipes that turn Salesforce and external data into datasets at the right grain.
servicesDesc.saql: Hand-written queries for the metrics the builder cannot express: windowing, cogroup, compare tables.
servicesDesc.security: Row-level security predicates and sharing inheritance that hold up in an audit.
servicesDesc.einstein: Stories and models with predictions written back to records — and checked before anyone trusts a score.
servicesDesc.rescue: A project that slipped: we review what exists, fix what blocks it, and get it to a release.
servicesDesc.training: Hands-on sessions for your admins, analysts and developers, on your own org and data.

how.title: Shared responsibility, by design
how.lead: Every project has a named lead who owns the outcome and a second expert who reviews the work before you see it. Nobody delivers alone.

steps.d: You tell us the goal, the data and the deadline through the form below. No account needed.
A short call to agree scope, milestones and price. You get it in writing before anything starts.
We match a lead expert and a reviewer from the network to your project, by skill and time zone.
Work ships in small, reviewed milestones. You see progress every week and sign off each one.
Documentation, a walkthrough for your team, and everything in your org — nothing locked in our heads.

items.a: Independent CRM Analytics consultants, admins and developers. Each one applied, was reviewed on past work, and delivers under the network’s rules: a named lead, a second reviewer, written milestones.
Per project, after the scoping call — a fixed price per milestone or an agreed day rate. You see the price in writing before anything starts.

items.q: What does “shared responsibility” mean for us?
items.a: You always have one named lead to talk to, and a second expert reviews every milestone before it reaches you. If the lead becomes unavailable, the reviewer already knows the project.

items.q: Do you work in our org?
items.a: Yes, with the access you grant — usually a sandbox first, then production for the release. Everything we build stays in your org.

items.q: Can you train our team as well?
items.a: Yes. Many projects end with hands-on sessions on your own dashboards, and the free course stays available to everyone afterwards.
